ESV.1: But the LORD said to Moses, “Now you shall see what I will do to Pharaoh; for with a strong hand he will send them out, and with a strong hand he will drive them out of his land.”
ESV.2: God spoke to Moses and said to him, “I am the LORD.
ESV.3: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, as God Almighty,  but by my name the LORD I did not make myself known to them.
ESV.4: I also established my covenant with them to give them the land of Canaan, the land in which they lived as sojourners.
ESV.5: Moreover, I have heard the groaning of the people of Israel whom the Egyptians hold as slaves, and I have remembered my covenant.
ESV.6: Say therefore to the people of Israel, ‘I am the LORD, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will deliver you from slavery to them, and I will redeem you with an outstretched arm and with great acts of judgment.
ESV.7: I will take you to be my people, and I will be your God, and you shall know that I am the LORD your God, who has brought you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.
ESV.8: I will bring you into the land that I swore to give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob. I will give it to you for a possession. I am the LORD.’”
ESV.9: Moses spoke thus to the people of Israel, but they did not listen to Moses, because of their broken spirit and harsh slavery.
ESV.10: So the LORD said to Moses,
ESV.11: “Go in, tell Pharaoh king of Egypt to let the people of Israel go out of his land.”
ESV.12: But Moses said to the LORD, “Behold, the people of Israel have not listened to me. How then shall Pharaoh listen to me, for I am of uncircumcised lips?”
ESV.13: But the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron and gave them a charge about the people of Israel and about Pharaoh king of Egypt: to bring the people of Israel out of the land of Egypt.
ESV.14: These are the heads of their fathers' houses: the sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi; these are the clans of Reuben.
ESV.15: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul, the son of a Canaanite woman; these are the clans of Simeon.
ESV.16: These are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari, the years of the life of Levi being 137 years.
ESV.17: The sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei, by their clans.
ESV.18: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, the years of the life of Kohath being 133 years.
ESV.19: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the clans of the Levites according to their generations.
ESV.20: Amram took as his wife Jochebed his father's sister, and she bore him Aaron and Moses, the years of the life of Amram being 137 years.
ESV.21: The sons of Izhar: Korah, Nepheg, and Zichri.
ESV.22: The sons of Uzziel: Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri.
ESV.23: Aaron took as his wife Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab and the sister of Nahshon, and she bore him Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
ESV.24: The sons of Korah: Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph; these are the clans of the Korahites.
ESV.25: Eleazar, Aaron's son, took as his wife one of the daughters of Putiel, and she bore him Phinehas. These are the heads of the fathers' houses of the Levites by their clans.
ESV.26: These are the Aaron and Moses to whom the LORD said: “Bring out the people of Israel from the land of Egypt by their hosts.”
ESV.27: It was they who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt about bringing out the people of Israel from Egypt, this Moses and this Aaron.
ESV.28: On the day when the LORD spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt,
ESV.29: the LORD said to Moses, “I am the LORD; tell Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say to you.”
ESV.30: But Moses said to the LORD, “Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips. How will Pharaoh listen to me?”

NASB.22: The sons of Uzziel: Mishael and Elzaphan and Sithri.

NLT.1: Then the LORD told Moses, “Now you will see what I will do to Pharaoh. When he feels the force of my strong hand, he will let the people go. In fact, he will force them to leave his land!”
NLT.2: And God said to Moses, “I am Yahweh — ‘the LORD.’
NLT.3: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob as El-Shaddai — ‘God Almighty’ — but I did not reveal my name, Yahweh, to them.
NLT.4: And I reaffirmed my covenant with them. Under its terms, I promised to give them the land of Canaan, where they were living as foreigners.
NLT.5: You can be sure that I have heard the groans of the people of Israel, who are now slaves to the Egyptians. And I am well aware of my covenant with them.
NLT.6: “Therefore, say to the people of Israel: ‘I am the LORD. I will free you from your oppression and will rescue you from your slavery in Egypt. I will redeem you with a powerful arm and great acts of judgment.
NLT.7: I will claim you as my own people, and I will be your God. Then you will know that I am the LORD your God who has freed you from your oppression in Egypt.
NLT.8: I will bring you into the land I swore to give to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I will give it to you as your very own possession. I am the LORD!’”
NLT.9: So Moses told the people of Israel what the LORD had said, but they refused to listen anymore. They had become too discouraged by the brutality of their slavery.
NLT.10: Then the LORD said to Moses,
NLT.11: “Go back to Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, and tell him to let the people of Israel leave his country.”
NLT.12: “But LORD!” Moses objected. “My own people won’t listen to me anymore. How can I expect Pharaoh to listen? I’m such a clumsy speaker! ”
NLT.13: But the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron and gave them orders for the Israelites and for Pharaoh, the king of Egypt. The LORD commanded Moses and Aaron to lead the people of Israel out of Egypt.
NLT.14: These are the ancestors of some of the clans of Israel: The sons of Reuben, Israel’s oldest son, were Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi. Their descendants became the clans of Reuben.
NLT.15: The sons of Simeon were Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar, and Shaul. (Shaul’s mother was a Canaanite woman.) Their descendants became the clans of Simeon.
NLT.16: These are the descendants of Levi, as listed in their family records: The sons of Levi were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari. (Levi lived to be 137 years old.)
NLT.17: The descendants of Gershon included Libni and Shimei, each of whom became the ancestor of a clan.
NLT.18: The descendants of Kohath included Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel. (Kohath lived to be 133 years old.)
NLT.19:
The descendants of Merari included Mahli and Mushi.
These are the clans of the Levites, as listed in their family records.
NLT.20: Amram married his father’s sister Jochebed, and she gave birth to his sons, Aaron and Moses. (Amram lived to be 137 years old.)
NLT.21: The sons of Izhar were Korah, Nepheg, and Zicri.
NLT.22: The sons of Uzziel were Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri.
NLT.23: Aaron married Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab and sister of Nahshon, and she gave birth to his sons, Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
NLT.24: The sons of Korah were Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph. Their descendants became the clans of Korah.
NLT.25: Eleazar son of Aaron married one of the daughters of Putiel, and she gave birth to his son, Phinehas. These are the ancestors of the Levite families, listed according to their clans.
NLT.26: The Aaron and Moses named in this list are the same ones to whom the LORD said, “Lead the people of Israel out of the land of Egypt like an army.”
NLT.27: It was Moses and Aaron who spoke to Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, about leading the people of Israel out of Egypt.
NLT.28: When the LORD spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt,
NLT.29: he said to him, “I am the LORD! Tell Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, everything I am telling you.”
NLT.30: But Moses argued with the LORD, saying, “I can’t do it! I’m such a clumsy speaker! Why should Pharaoh listen to me?”

NET.25: Now Eleazar son of Aaron married one of the daughters of Putiel and she bore him Phinehas. These are the heads of the fathers’ households of Levi according to their clans.
NET.26: It was the same Aaron and Moses to whom the LORD said, “Bring the Israelites out of the land of Egypt by their regiments.”
NET.27: They were the men who were speaking to Pharaoh king of Egypt, in order to bring the Israelites out of Egypt. It was the same Moses and Aaron.
NET.28: When the LORD spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt,
NET.29: he said to him, “I am the LORD. Tell Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I am telling you.”
NET.30: But Moses said before the LORD, “Since I speak with difficulty, why should Pharaoh listen to me?”
